question: What did Trump say about Iran at the UN, and how did Iran answer?

lines.text: 22 September. Trump flies into New York to address the United Nations.
On Iran, he laid out the choice: a deal, or annihilation.

scene.quote: Do I annihilate the Islamic Republic and do it quickly

lines.text: He said he expects a deal right after the midterm elections.
Iran's delegation walked out of the hall.
The next day, Iran's president answered him from the same stage.

scene.quote: We will never bow our head or bend at the knee

lines.text: As he spoke, a member of the US delegation walked out.
Threats, walkouts, and both sides still say they want to talk.

caption: Trump told the UN he could make a deal with Iran or 'annihilate' it. Iran's delegation walked out, and a day later Iran's president answered from the same stage.
